entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Archangel of Innistrad who consorted with monsters; destroyed by Avacyn a thousand years ago and later restored.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel who appeared from nowhere, inflexible in righteousness, and destroyed Liesa and her flight.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: Angelic sister who protected the dead.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angelic sister who protected the living.

entities.name: The Buried Lord
entities.description: Powerful demon who made a pact with Liesa and could not die.

entities.name: Algli
entities.description: Surviving cultist who helped Liesa hunt the demon and pledged herself to Liesa.

events.summary: Liesa forms a pact with the Buried Lord; Avacyn declares her a heretic.
events.quote: When Liesa formed a pact with a powerful demon

events.summary: Avacyn single-handedly destroys Liesa and her small flight and forbids the mention of her name.
events.quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed Liesa and her entire small flight

events.summary: Liesa struggles for centuries to reform, allowed by her pact with the undying Buried Lord.
events.quote: Because the Buried Lord could not die, their shared pact allowed Liesa to reform upon his return.

events.summary: Summoned by cultists, Liesa is fully restored and freed from the pact and helps Algli hunt the demon master.
events.quote: Liesa was fully restored to life and freed from the pact.

events.summary: Algli pledges herself to Liesa's service as the first of her new flock.
events.quote: Algli pledged herself to Liesa's service, becoming the first of her new flock.

relations.quote: Liesa, Bruna , Gisela , and Sigarda were angelic sisters
Avacyn single-handedly destroyed Liesa and her entire small flight
Liesa deeply regretted trusting the Buried Lord
Algli pledged herself to Liesa's service, becoming the first of her new flock.
